text_block_list.text:
Stay Gold's condition hasn't been the 
best as of late, so to change things up, 
we visited a shrine.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Mumumu… I want… My gaze… to become softer…!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Wah! Stego and… Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Did you hear all that? Uhm～ I've just been a little curious about it.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Ahh, the gaze you make when you get angry?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Uuu… It's not really a good trait is it? And like… I might end up scaring the people around me.

As this was a topic that seemed to bother 
her, I was searching for the right words to 
respond with when…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Isn't it fine? I don't hate it either.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Even if you seem scary, you're still you 
on the inside right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I see…… My heart, won't change.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I was too scared of causing any 
misunderstandings, and my timidness 
made me even more worried about it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I think I feel a 
little better now.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Is that right. Well, having a scary gaze isn't 
a bad thing per se. There are times when 
it's actually quite useful.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Useful……?

text_block_list.name: Crow
text_block_list.text: Caw! Cacaw!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Eep! A crow……!? Uuuuu, Crows are the one thing —!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
W-W-What if, this is god showing 
their anger…!?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hmm —……We're in the middle of something right now.

Stay Gold turned away from Narita Top Road 
and without a single word, threw an intense 
glare at the crow. Struck with panic, the 
crow scurried off to the sky…!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Phew～ You made it go away……! But, how were you able to shoo it so quickly?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Who knows. Maybe god up there gave 
me a little hand in all this?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks and how you present yourself 
with your good deeds. That's all you need.

Stay Gold left cheerfully. From this one 
mystical occurrence, that girl's troubled 
mood has been entirely healed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Eeekkk! I think it came back!? And huh, it called it's friends over too……!?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Shoot, I may have made the situation worse.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
No can do. Trainer, can you go hide her 
somewhere for me.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Ahhhhhhhh～～～～～～! Shoo…… Ahhh～～～～

Stay Gold ran out of the shrine grounds as 
she was shooing the flock away. Due to this 
ominous event, we weren't able to help with 
Narita Top Road's poor condition.
